seats.notes: Black-green build, since green is deep and BG was the best-performing pair, with Bloodline Keeper as the top finisher. Cut Naturalize, Mulch, Gnaw to the Bone, and the white and red cards; 17 lands split 10 Forest and 7 Swamp to match green's weight.

…Stitched Drake, Sturmgeist, Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, and Urgent Exorcism, backed by Unruly Mob, Village Bell-Ringer, and Spectral Rider. Cut the red cards, the second Urgent Exorcism, Ancient Grudge, Pitchburn Devils, and the second Harvest Pyre, which don't fit the two-colour plan.

…Ironsmiths and Kessig Wolves, backed by Morkrut Banshee, Stromkirk Patrol, Tribute to Hunger, Dead Weight and Brimstone Volley. Cut the green cards, the second Plunge, Blasphemous Act and the extra Bump; 17 lands including Stensia Bloodhall, with 8 Swamp and 8 Mountain for the black-heavy count.

…with good creatures and removal (Fiend Hunter, Smite), backed by red burn (Brimstone Volley, Geistflame, Harvest Pyre) and two Ashmouth Hounds. Cut the weaker equipment, second Ghostly Possession, Nevermore, and the expensive Heretic's Punishment; Galvanic Juggernaut and Scourge carry the top end.

Green-white: green is deep and the white adds real removal (Fiend Hunter, Rebuke, Smite the Monstrous) plus Mausoleum Guard bodies, which beats the thin black pool. I cut the black cards, the blue cards, and the weak ramp and equipment, keeping 17 lands for a 23-spell curve.

Mono-blue is the deepest option: my blue pool supplies 23 playables, with red too thin to add much. The deck runs Skaab and flyer creatures, plus Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Grasp of Phantoms and counters, on 17 Islands. Red cards and the weak aura and equipment cards are cut.

White is the deepest colour, so I'm building white-green: white creatures and Rebuke/Smite/Bonds for removal, with Prey Upon and the green bodies as the second colour. Cut Woodland Sleuth to reach 23 spells, and split 10 Plains and 7 Forest for the white-heavy curve.

…around Bloodgift Demon, Morkrut Banshee, and cheap removal (Dead Weight, Victim of Night, Corpse Lunge), with evasion via Invisible Stalker, Vampire Interloper, Screeching Bat, and Spectral Flight. Cut the weaker curses, Crab, second Night Terrors, second Forbidden Alchemy, and Gruesome Deformity.
